Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: After surfacing an authoritative but conflicting source (the Canadian Film Encyclopedia snippet showing St. John’s, Newfoundland), WebSurfer relied on search-result snippets and low-credibility aggregators instead of opening and verifying the primary source to reconcile the conflict. This failure to validate led toward an incorrect birthplace conclusion (defaulting to Winnipeg from secondary sources) rather than resolving the discrepancy.
